sources.title: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
sources.findings: Uses a million procedural fractal images and parameter-derived triplets. Reported retrieval gains follow natural-data fine-tuning with Proxy-Anchor; they are not one-reference, synthetic-only detection scores. Its parameter-distance ordering agrees with rendered structural ordering in some sampling regimes but falls below chance in others.
sources.implication_for_hypernet: Relational supervision from mathematical generators is existing prior art. Validate which geometric variations should preserve a type instead of assuming parameter distance is semantic distance. The present v19 graph edits, visible-point correspondences and conditional region scoring differ from that experiment, but those differences do not establish novelty or superiority.

sources.title: Stylized Structural Patterns for Improved Neural Network Pre-training
sources.findings: Combines neural fractal structure with visual features transferred from a small real-image set. Its reported gains include classification and generative tasks.
sources.implication_for_hypernet: This supports investigating the appearance gap but does not validate our mathematical-only constraint. Importing real-photo style features or a borrowed generator would change the current experiment.

current_run_action: Keep the fixed model and curriculum. Complete the planned synthetic diagnostics and untouched natural-photo comparison before drawing a transfer conclusion.
